checks.name: Development Split Conformance
checks.requirement: Evaluated exactly 107 development tiles; locked holdout (107) and quarantine (42) untouched.
checks.evidence: Split manifest verified: len(dev_tiles)==107, zero overlap with holdout or quarantined partitions.

checks.name: Hard-Mask Reproduction Gate
checks.requirement: Reproduce hard top-10%, 20%, 30% and S0/Ensemble baselines within numerical precision.

checks.name: Reference-Independent Tau Root-Finding
checks.requirement: Threshold tau determined strictly from frozen hybrid uncertainty map and budget B without reference metrics.
checks.evidence: Tau solved using 1D Brent root-finding on sigmoid(u - tau) matching target budgets (0.10, 0.20, 0.30) to < 10^-6 tolerance.

checks.name: Prespecified Primary Beta
checks.requirement: Primary beta = 0.20 selected prior to evaluation; sensitivity grid treated as secondary.
checks.evidence: Primary beta locked at 0.20; sensitivity grid (0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40) evaluated with multiple-testing caveats.

checks.name: Prespecified Boundary Band Construction
checks.requirement: Morphological boundary band around hard mask constructed prior to metric calculation.
checks.evidence: 3-pixel wide boundary ribbon defined via dilation minus erosion (dil & ~ero) of hard 20% mask; identical region used for all arms.

checks.name: Visual Failure Case Prespecification
checks.requirement: Failure cases selected based on prior EXP-022 rankings without post-hoc selection.
checks.evidence: Top 3 degraded (27398_49397, 24552_52637, 30541_51662), top 3 improved, and 1 neutral tile analyzed.

checks.name: Perception-Distortion Guardrail Compliance
checks.requirement: Report explicitly states smoother boundaries do not prove enhanced super-resolution or authentic detail.
